{"path": "tests/test_handler_exists.py", "file_text": "
from app.api.handlers import handle_user_exists

def test_handle_user_exists():
    # Test existing user
    assert handle_user_exists({"id": "1"}) == (200, {"exists": True})
    
    # Test non-existing user
    assert handle_user_exists({"id": "999"}) == (200, {"exists": False})
    
    # Test invalid id: missing
    assert handle_user_exists({}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
    
    # Test invalid id: not string
    assert handle_user_exists({"id": 1}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
    
    # Test invalid id: not digits
    assert handle_user_exists({"id": "abc"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
    assert handle_user_exists({"id": "1a"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_handle_user_exists()
    print("All tests passed!")
"}
